> NBAA CPA(T) review classes for Foundation, Intermediate and Final levels, plus auditing, taxation, finance and accounting consultation, at the YMCA Building, Upanga Road, Posta, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Motto: "Integrity in professionalism with experience".

- AGC is among the top ranked registered centres for NBAA CPA(T) review classes.
- Fees are given on request by WhatsApp or phone.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Associate Group of Consultants (AGC)?

AGC is a centre for professional accountancy training and consultancy in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It prepares students for the NBAA CPA(T) examinations at Foundation, Intermediate and Final levels, and provides auditing, taxation, finance and accounting consultation to companies, NGOs and individuals.

### Where is AGC located?

AGC is at the YMCA Building, Upanga Road, Posta, opposite the former Holiday Inn Hotel, Dar es Salaam.

### Which CPA levels does AGC teach?

All three NBAA CPA(T) levels: Foundation (subjects A1 to A6), Intermediate (B1 to B5, plus Government, Ethics and Management) and Final (C1 to C4).

### When are the CPA classes held?

Weekday evening classes run from 17:30 to 21:00, with additional sessions on Saturday and Sunday. The November 2026 timetable for each level is on the CPA Classes page.

### Are the classes in person?

Yes. Classes are taught in person at AGC's classrooms in the YMCA Building, Upanga, Dar es Salaam.

### How much are the CPA class fees?

Contact AGC for current fees by WhatsApp or phone on 0712 311 100.

### How do I enroll for CPA classes at AGC?

Enrollment takes one message or call: WhatsApp or call 0712 311 100 or 0739 311 100, or email victornicholouc@gmail.com.

### What consultation services does AGC offer?

Auditing, taxation (tax planning, TRA compliance, filing of returns and VAT matters), finance consultation and accounting consultation, for companies, NGOs and individuals.

### Is the first consultation free?

Yes. AGC starts with a free initial discussion: it looks at your situation, scopes the work and gives you a clear quotation, with no obligation.

### Is AGC a registered CPA review centre?

Yes. AGC is among the top ranked registered centres for NBAA CPA(T) review classes.
